title: Timestamp-aligned QA evidence and discrepancies
description: Exact copy, assets and timing are distinct from image metrics. No schema field represents a universal visual-quality score.

thresholds.description: Comparator-specific calibrated threshold map. Keys and JSON value representations are intentionally open; calibration and metric semantics are checked in code.

alignment.description: Explicit source-to-render timestamp/frame mapping and review metadata. Comparator-specific keys and mapping representations are intentionally open; VFR alignment must be reviewed.

metrics.description: Named numeric measurement map. Null means not measured; values have metric-specific units and must not be combined into an uncalibrated universal score.

regions.description: Per-region scores of one sampled frame, in full-frame pixels. Null means region scoring was disabled or could not run. Region keys stay open because they are comparator-specific; the diagnostic vocabulary and the patch noise floor are checked in code.

regionsSampledFrame.description: Frame index the regions array was measured on; region scores are never averaged across an animated shot.

evidence.description: Comparator-specific evidence, including measurements and source/render references. Keys intentionally remain open; evidence sufficiency, alignment and correction eligibility are checked in code.

priority.description: Nonnegative ordering value; prioritization policy and correction eligibility are validated in code.
